name: Verdexa
tagline: The regulatory operating system for the legal cannabis enterprise.
positioning: Verdexa unifies seed-to-sale tracking, license governance, and audit-grade reporting into one control plane for multi-state cannabis operators.

hero.h1: Compliance that scales with every license you hold.
hero.sub: Verdexa turns fragmented state mandates, METRC syncs, and audit trails into a single governed system of record — built for operators running across dozens of jurisdictions.

features.title: Unified license governance
features.description: Track every state license, renewal deadline, and bond requirement in one ledger — with automated escalations before a permit ever lapses.

features.title: Real-time METRC reconciliation
features.description: Continuously sync tag-level inventory against state traceability systems and surface variances the moment they appear, not at month-end.

features.title: Audit-grade evidence vault
features.description: Every SOP, lab result, and manifest is versioned, timestamped, and export-ready — so a surprise inspection becomes a two-click response.

features.title: Multi-state rule engine
features.description: Codified regulations for every legal market, updated as statutes change, so your compliance team stops maintaining spreadsheets by hand.

features.title: Deviation intelligence
features.description: Machine-scored risk on every batch, transfer, and disposal event, ranked so your directors act on what actually threatens the license.

features.title: Executive assurance reporting
features.description: Board-ready compliance posture across every entity, generated on demand for regulators, investors, and acquisition due diligence.

testimonials.quote: We consolidated eleven states of compliance workflows onto Verdexa in a single quarter. Our variance backlog dropped by 90% and our auditors now trust the system of record more than our own spreadsheets.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: The reconciliation engine caught a manifest discrepancy that would have triggered a state investigation. Verdexa paid for itself in the first month of deployment across our retail footprint.
testimonials.name: Marcus Bellamy

testimonials.quote: Preparing for our acquisition, we needed audit-grade evidence across every entity. Verdexa produced it in an afternoon. That level of assurance moved the deal forward.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramanathan
